# Umbo

> Umbo is an oyster bar and restaurant in Traverse City, Michigan, from chef Cameron Rolka and Sarah Welch — the team behind Marrow and Mink in Detroit. The menu centers on oysters, tinned fish and conservas, caviar, and coastal small plates, with an all-Michigan natural wine list, plus Michigan beer and cider. Dinner service, vintage-seaside room, reservations by text.

## Key facts

- Name: Umbo
- Type: Oyster bar & restaurant (seafood)
- Address: 430 E. Front Street, Traverse City, MI 49686, USA
- Phone: (231) 944-2797
- Email: sarah@eatumbo.com
- Hours: Thursday–Monday, 4:30pm–9:30pm. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
- Reservations: by text, for parties of 2–5, seated at the indoor bar. Parties of 6 or more are seated on the patio, first come, first served. At least a third of the bar is held for walk-ins; the patio is seated when the weather cooperates, also first come, first served. A private dining space for larger parties is in progress.
- Cuisine: seafood, oysters, tinned fish and conservas, caviar
- Drinks: all-Michigan natural wine, Michigan beer and cider
- Price range: $$$
- Owners: Cameron Rolka (chef) and Sarah Welch
- Also from the team behind: Marrow and Mink, Detroit
